description: This file contains functions for bucketing and managing FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) all_gather and reduce_scatter operations within the PyTorch FX graph framework, including utility functions to identify graph input/output nodes and to perform bucketing passes.

methods.name: is_graph_input
methods.description: Checks if a node is a graph input (placeholder).

methods.name: is_fsdp_all_gather_wait
methods.description: Determines if a node is a wait condition for FSDP all_gather.

methods.name: is_graph_output
methods.description: Checks if a node is a graph output.

methods.name: is_fsdp_reduce_scatter_wait
methods.description: Determines if a node is a wait condition for FSDP reduce_scatter.

methods.name: bucket_fsdp_all_gather
methods.description: Performs bucketing for FSDP all_gather operations in a FX graph module.

methods.name: bucket_fsdp_reduce_scatter
methods.description: Performs bucketing for FSDP reduce_scatter operations in a FX graph module.
